Name: Red Panda Barn Animals for Content Patcher
Author: unamazement
Description:
This adds red pandas as [b]barn [/b]animals. They are cheaper than sheep and drop special wool [b]every 3 days[/b] that can be made into orange cloth on a loom.

[b]You must install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and use SMAPI. [/b]Drag the folder inside the .zip into your Mods folder.

The wool and cloth are a little cheaper than regular wool and cloth for balance reasons. The red pandas take 4 days to grow up. They make a chirping sound that real red pandas make.

I made the sprites by altering the raccoon sprites that were added to the game in 1.6.

The red pandas are admittedly almost as big as cows, but don't let that scare you.
